title: Infame Coaching Methodology (Author) Definition
description: Schema for a single coaching methodology. One file per author under config/authors/. This is the single source of truth: the engine, the validator, and the generated Claude Project files all read from here.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Must match the filename stem. Never change once in use.

name.description: Display name, as it appears in generated Markdown headings. E.g. 'Coggan Cycling Levels'.

sport_note.description: Optional refinement shown in generated output when the sport label alone is imprecise. E.g. 'Ultrarunning / Running'.

zone_identifier_style.description: How this author names zones. E.g. 'Level N', 'Zone N (with sub-zone letters)', 'Letter code (workout code)'.

default_metric.description: Metric used when the athlete declares no preference.

available_metrics.description: Metrics this author defines. A zone range column may only exist for a metric listed here (Schema Extension Rule 1).

primary_metrics.description: Human-readable physiological references. E.g. 'Power', 'Lactate Threshold Heart Rate (LTHR)'.

intensity_anchors.description: Optional. Anchors as displayed in generated output. Defaults to available_metrics rendering when omitted.

metric_status.description: Whether each metric is native to the author or a cross-referenced estimate. Keys must appear in available_metrics.

dual_layer.description: Present only when the athlete-facing cue metric differs from the engine-facing load metric (Schema Extension Rule 3).

engine_metric.description: Metric emitted in Intervals.icu syntax; feeds platform load calculation.

steering_metric.description: Metric the athlete reads on the device, carried in the cue text.

steering_label.description: Optional. Overrides the steering description, e.g. 'RPE per workout code'.

special_output_rule.description: Present only when the native intensity metric must NOT be the metric emitted in syntax (Schema Extension Rule 2). Worked example: Olbrich.

notes.description: Author-level notes rendered as bullet lines in generated Markdown. Use for deliberate zone gaps, FTHR=LTHR equivalences, field-test pointers.

zones.description: Zone rows in ascending intensity order.

key.description: The author's native zone identifier, preserved verbatim. E.g. 'Level 4', 'Zone 5 / 5a', 'SSR'.

physiological_class.description: Cross-author physiological class. Drives TSS cost via config/tss_classes.yaml. This is the only valid bridge between methodologies — never RPE (Schema Extension Rule 4).

ranges.description: Numeric range per metric. Keys must appear in available_metrics. Omit a metric entirely where the author defines none (renders as N/A).

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. null means open (renders '< max').

max.description: Inclusive upper bound. null means open (renders '> min').

rpe.description: Author's own RPE calibration. Not comparable across authors (Schema Extension Rule 4).

label.description: Use when the author states a non-numeric value, e.g. 'Maximal'.

note.description: Row-level note. Rendered in the Notes column.

metric_labels.description: Optional per-author override of the column label for a metric. Use when the author's own vocabulary differs from the default, e.g. Palladino writes '% FTP/CP' rather than '% FTP'.

default_metric_label.description: Optional. Overrides how the default metric is displayed when the author qualifies it, e.g. 'RPE (workout-code specific)'.
